Remark
[Chain rule for Laplacian and Hessian]

Source: petersen:page-0089 ↗ def:pet-ch2-laplacian ↗ def:pet-ch2-hessian-lie-derivative

1. ch2:2.5.6For $f:M\to \mathbb {R}$ and $\phi :\mathbb {R}\to \mathbb {R}$, \[ \begin{aligned} \Delta (\phi \circ f) & =\dot\phi (f)\Delta f+\ddot\phi (f)|df|^2,\\ \operatorname {Hess}(\phi \circ f) & =\dot\phi (f)\operatorname {Hess}f+\ddot\phi (f)\, df^2. \end{aligned} \]
